source_text: For HIV prevention, three randomized controlled trials in sub-Saharan Africa demonstrated that adult male circumcision reduces heterosexual HIV acquisition by about 60%, prompting World Health Organization recommendations for voluntary medical male circumcision in high-prevalence regions. [121] [122]
